## Summary

Keep the preceding measured class during a pointer transform, then measure the edited design when the gesture ends. This is the small class-timing checkpoint after merged #50.

```text
begin transform → retain class
move → edit geometry; retain class and derived GP budget
release → clear retained class and measure edited design
cancel → clear retained class and restore design
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The new mock regression failed: resizing a Huge Base Bubble displayed Class 4 while the pointer was held and Class 2 was required.
  **After:** Both supplied-SWF and mock flows export changed scale during the hold while class/budget remain stable, increase class on release, and restore prior parts/class with one Undo.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 486 rule tests (6,040 assertions), production build and all four affected browser cases pass (47.5s, no skips).
- ActionScript resize move/release and their bytecode confirm this timing. Correct the backlog documentation: rotation release has no direct class-update call. This editor still remeasures on either transform release, so exact rotation-release behavior remains explicit open fidelity work.
- No media, generated data, persistence schema or saved drag-fix changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores immediate class measurement during pointer transforms.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Class-based readouts, validation and affordability share the retained class until the gesture ends.

Revert removes the unused palette cache entries and fixture coverage.

Adds raster preparation to supplied-SWF loading. Mock assets retain their existing path.

output.body:
## Summary

Read editable text line spacing as signed little-endian bytes before importing palette typography. This is a small parser prerequisite after #52.

```diff
 parseEditTextTag
-  leading = signed bit field (most-significant bit first)
+  leading = signed little-endian 16-bit integer
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The new regression expected authored leading 40 and received 10,240.
  **After:** Zero, positive/negative, larger and signed-boundary values pass while following variable name/alignment/margins stay intact.
- An independent Python raw-tag reader agrees with all 237 original editable text fields. Before/after inventories differ only in leading for 232 fields; all other parsed fields are identical. Original values include -80, 0 and 40.
- [FFDec reads Leading as SI16](https://github.com/jindrapetrik/jpexs-decompiler/blob/master/libsrc/ffdec_lib/src/com/jpexs/decompiler/flash/tags/DefineEditTextTag.java#L387-L392); its [signed reader combines low then high bytes](https://github.com/jindrapetrik/jpexs-decompiler/blob/master/libsrc/ffdec_lib/src/com/jpexs/decompiler/flash/SWFInputStream.java#L761-L766).
- Formatting, TypeScript, 487 rule/parser tests (6,047 assertions) and production build pass. No current runtime consumer reads leading, so palette typography and affected browser verification follow separately. No generated data/media changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the old parser expression.

**Blast Radius:** parser

Corrects parsed line-spacing metadata; existing text paint is unchanged until later integration.
output.title: fix: read signed editable text leading in byte order
output.head: fix/edit-text-leading

## Summary

Import numerical palette geometry and typography before connecting the UI. This is the data slice of the palette checkpoint after #53.

```text
authored SWF + local catalog source
  → repeatable importer
  → numeric palette table + typed fields
  → metadata regressions
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** Palette registrations and field metrics are absent from the recreation data.
  **After:** Six tabs, seven stats fields, a 141×67 preview, 182px list mask, scrollbar/row states, 93 indicators and numerical character advances are retained.
- Two imports are byte-identical to the original backlog table: 22,507 bytes, SHA256 `2ff3e4ef4b720e778cd1306e638120610a6dbad316fe91902425c46373dd59d8`.
- An independent raw SWF reader verifies 21 registration/field groups, including matrices, dimensions, font variants, color, wrapping and line-height arithmetic. Metadata regressions protect preview/mask/row dimensions, mirrored scrollbar registration and exact catalog-ID indicator coverage.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 488 rule/parser tests (6,058 assertions) pass. No runtime caller consumes the table yet; artwork/text/components/integration and browser comparisons follow separately. No original contours, glyph outlines or media are committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Remove the unused table/importer and optional field declarations to revert.

**Blast Radius:** data

Future palette consumers use these metrics. Shipped UI behavior is unchanged.

output.body:
## Summary

Recover pure palette behavior before UI integration. This is the rules slice after #54.

```text
scroll drag → clamp18..138 / divide by121 → list offset
scroll arrow → round negative offset → row step → separate120px handle span
weapon summary → category counts/order → source name variant + trailing comma
mock text → numeric advances + paragraph wrapping
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The numerical table has no palette scroll/summary/text helpers.
  **After:** Source-derived regressions protect limits, 1.5px row overhang, distinct arrow/drag spans, category ordering/plurals, discarded-substr quirks, paragraph wrapping and caption advances.
- An 18-row fixture at handle Y38 gives exactly 30px offset; the next down arrow yields 40.333px. Replacing negative rounding with positive rounding produces one failure at 60.5px while the other four new cases pass. The verified implementation was restored byte for byte.
- ActionScript and bytecode confirm the scroll arithmetic, passive mount order and two discarded `substr` results. Current four-digit catalog IDs make numeric ordering agree with the source default string sort.
- Formatting, TypeScript and all 493 rule/parser tests (6,091 assertions) pass. These new exports have no runtime caller yet; no affected browser flow changes in this slice. Artwork/components/integration follow separately.
- Mock wrapping, missing-glyph fallback, kerning and full Flash text layout remain approximate/unverified. No media or generated data changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Remove the unused helpers and tests to revert.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Future palette/stat components consume these rules. Current UI behavior is unchanged.
